vetSays.line: 📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 80. I've been watching what you're becoming, little unkillable. Names for your shelf: Cold-Blooded, Blood Price. What they DO — that's still yours to learn."
🛡️ Ursula, Renee, Saul, Amina and Diana met them at the door — 5 put down. Ursula, Renee, Saul, Amina, Diana are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Amina was ready to hunt Spool — but the fire says that kind is already put down, and no one has seen another trail. The hunt is called off."
🛡️ Ursula, Renee, Jorge, Maya and Pavel met them at the door — 5 put down. Ursula, Renee, Jorge, Maya, Pavel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pavel just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Ursula, Jorge, Pavel and Victor met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Jorge, Pavel are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Xolani and Mabel met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Xolani, Mabel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mabel just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Xolani, Mabel and Laura met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Xolani, Laura are hurt.
🛡️ Xolani, Mabel and Valentin met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Xolani, Mabel, Valentin are hurt.
🛡️ Xolani, Mabel and Valentin met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Xolani, Mabel, Valentin are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mabel just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Xolani, Mabel, Laura and Valentin met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Laura, Valentin are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mabel just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Xolani, Mabel, Laura and Valentin met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Laura didn't come back. Mabel, Valentin are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xolani just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Xolani, Rihab and Ole met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Xolani, Rihab, Ole are hurt.
🛡️ Ole met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rihab just put down The Nielsen... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
